# Aptlystar Documentation

> The enterprise AI workspace where teams build, deploy, and manage AI agents.

Aptlystar is the proprietary enterprise AI workspace where teams build, deploy, and manage AI agents. Connect 1,000+ integrations and every major LLM to create agents that automate real work — visually, conversationally, or with code. Trusted by over 100,000 builders.

## Documentation Overview

This file provides an overview of our documentation. For full content of all pages, see https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/llms-full.txt

## Main Sections

### Root

- Documentation: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en

### Agents

- Product agents: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/agents
  Create, deploy, and operate workflow-backed AI agents from the Agents hub
- Connect Slack to an agent: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/agents/slack
  Receive Slack messages in a product agent and reply from the same workflow

  Upload, create, edit, and generate files — documents, presentations, images, and more.

  Your AI command center. Build and manage your entire workspace in natural language.
- Knowledge Bases: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/astra/knowledge
  Create, populate, and query knowledge bases from Astra.
- Research: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/astra/research
  Ask Astra to research anything — it searches, reads, and synthesizes from the web.

  Create, query, and manage workspace tables from Astra.

  Schedule recurring jobs, take immediate actions, connect integrations, and configure your workspace.
- Workflows: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/astra/workflows
  Create, edit, run, debug, deploy, and organize workflows from Astra.

### Api Reference

- Authentication: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/authentication
  API key types, generation, and how to authenticate requests
- Getting Started: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/getting-started
  Base URL, first API call, response format, error handling, and pagination
- Python: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/python
- TypeScript: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/typescript
- Execute Workflow: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/workflows/executeWorkflow
  Execute a deployed workflow. Supports synchronous, asynchronous, and streaming modes. For async execution, the response includes a statusUrl you can poll for results.
- Cancel Execution: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/workflows/cancelExecution
  Cancel a running workflow execution. Only effective for executions that are still in progress.
- List Paused Executions: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/human-in-the-loop/listPausedExecutions
  List all paused executions for a workflow. Workflows pause at Human in the Loop blocks and wait for input before continuing. Use this endpoint to discover which executions need attention.
- Get Paused Execution: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/human-in-the-loop/getPausedExecution
  Get detailed information about a specific paused execution, including its pause points, execution snapshot, and resume queue. Use this to inspect the state before resuming.
- Get Paused Execution (Resume Path): https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/human-in-the-loop/getPausedExecutionByResumePath
  Get detailed information about a specific paused execution using the resume URL path. Returns the same data as the workflow paused execution detail endpoint.
- Get Pause Context: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/human-in-the-loop/getPauseContext
  Get detailed information about a specific pause context within a paused execution. Returns the pause point details, resume queue state, and any active resume entry.
- Resume Execution: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/human-in-the-loop/resumeExecution
  Resume a paused workflow execution by providing input for a specific pause context. The execution continues from where it paused, using the provided input. Supports synchronous, asynchronous, and streaming modes (determined by the original execution's configuration).
- List Workflows: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/workflows/listWorkflows
  Retrieve all workflows in a workspace with cursor-based pagination.
- Get Workflow: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/workflows/getWorkflow
  Retrieve details for a single workflow, including its input fields and deployment status.
- Get Job Status: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/workflows/getJobStatus
  Poll the status of an asynchronous workflow execution. Use the jobId returned from the Execute Workflow endpoint when the execution is queued asynchronously.
- Query Logs: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/logs/queryLogs
  List workflow execution logs with advanced filtering and cursor-based pagination. Supports filtering by workflow, trigger type, date range, duration, cost, and more.
- Get Log Details: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/logs/getLogDetails
  Retrieve detailed information about a specific log entry, including workflow metadata, execution data, and cost breakdown.
- Get Execution Details: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/logs/getExecutionDetails
  Retrieve the full execution state snapshot, including the workflow state at time of execution and detailed metadata.
- List Audit Logs: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/audit-logs/listAuditLogs
  Retrieve audit logs for your organization with cursor-based pagination. Requires an Enterprise subscription and organization admin or owner role.
- Get Audit Log Details: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/audit-logs/getAuditLogDetails
  Retrieve a single audit log entry by ID. Requires an Enterprise subscription and organization admin or owner role.
- Get Usage Limits: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/usage/getUsageLimits
  Retrieve your current rate limits, usage spending, and storage consumption for the billing period.
- List Tables: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/listTables
  List all tables in a workspace. Returns table metadata including name, schema, and row counts.
- Create Table: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/createTable
  Create a new table in a workspace. Define the table schema with typed columns, optional constraints (required, unique), and a name.
- Get Table: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/getTable
  Retrieve a table's metadata, schema, and row count.
- Delete Table: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/deleteTable
  Delete a table and all its rows. This action is irreversible.
- Add Column: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/addColumn
  Add a new column to the table schema. Optionally specify a position to insert the column at a specific index.
- Update Column: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/updateColumn
  Update a column's name, type, or constraints. Multiple updates can be applied in a single request. When renaming, subsequent updates (type, constraints) use the new name.
- Delete Column: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/deleteColumn
  Delete a column from the table schema. This removes the column definition and strips the corresponding key from all existing row data. Cannot delete the last remaining column.
- List Rows: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/listRows
  Query rows from a table with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Filters and sorts are passed as JSON-encoded query parameters.
- Insert Rows: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/insertRows
  Insert one or more rows into a table. For a single row, pass a `data` object. For batch insert, pass a `rows` array (up to 1000 rows).
- Batch Update Rows: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/batchUpdateRows
  Update multiple specific rows by their IDs in a single request. Each entry in the `updates` array specifies a row ID and the fields to update. Validates against the table schema and unique constraints. Up to 1000 rows can be updated per request.
- Delete Rows: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/deleteRows
  Delete rows by filter criteria or by an explicit list of row IDs. Pass either a `filter` object or a `rowIds` array.
- Update Rows: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/updateRows
  Bulk update rows matching a filter. All matching rows will have the specified fields updated. Validates against schema and unique constraints.
- Get Row: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/getRow
  Retrieve a single row by its ID.
- Update Row: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/updateRow
  Partially update a single row. Only the provided fields are updated; existing fields are preserved. Data is validated against the table schema.
- Delete Row: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/deleteRow
  Delete a single row by its ID.
- Upsert Row: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/tables/upsertRow
  Insert a new row or update an existing one based on a unique column value. The table must have at least one column with a unique constraint. If a row with a matching unique value exists, it is updated; otherwise, a new row is inserted. When multiple unique columns exist, specify `conflictTarget` to indicate which column to match on.
- List Files: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/files/listFiles
  List all files in a workspace.
- Upload File: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/files/uploadFile
  Upload a file to a workspace. Send the file as multipart/form-data with a `file` field and a `workspaceId` field. Maximum file size is 100MB. Duplicate filenames within a workspace are not allowed.
- Download File: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/files/downloadFile
  Download a file's content. Returns the raw file bytes with appropriate Content-Type, Content-Disposition, and Content-Length headers. File metadata is included in custom response headers: X-File-Id, X-File-Name, X-Uploaded-At.
- Delete File: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/files/deleteFile
  Delete a file from a workspace. This removes both the file content and its metadata. This action is irreversible.
- List Knowledge Bases: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/listKnowledgeBases
  List all knowledge bases in a workspace.
- Create Knowledge Base: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/createKnowledgeBase
  Create a new knowledge base in a workspace. Optionally configure chunking parameters for document processing.
- Get Knowledge Base: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/getKnowledgeBase
  Get details of a specific knowledge base.
- Delete Knowledge Base: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/deleteKnowledgeBase
  Soft-delete a knowledge base and all its documents.
- Update Knowledge Base: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/updateKnowledgeBase
  Update a knowledge base's name, description, or chunking configuration. At least one field must be provided.
- List Documents: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/listDocuments
  List documents in a knowledge base with pagination, filtering, and sorting.
- Upload Document: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/uploadDocument
  Upload a document to a knowledge base. The document will be processed asynchronously (chunked and embedded). Maximum file size is 100MB.
- Get Document: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/getDocument
  Get details of a specific document in a knowledge base.
- Delete Document: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/deleteDocument
  Soft-delete a document from a knowledge base. For connector-sourced documents, this also prevents re-import on future syncs.
- Search Knowledge Base: https://aptly-technology.github.io/aptlystar-docs/en/api-reference/knowledge-bases/searchKnowledgeBase
  Perform vector similarity search across one or more knowledge bases. Supports semantic search via query text, tag-based filtering, or a combination of both.
